facts.fact: Sep-2026 shareholding pattern filed (excluded under the as-of rule; Screener shows promoters 32.66%, FIIs 22.61%, DIIs 19.40%, public 25.31%, 147,026 holders).
Q2FY27 results: revenue Rs437 cr (+43% YoY), EBITDA Rs176 cr (40% margin), attributable profit Rs125 cr, EPS Rs15.29. Earnings call held the same day; transcript filed 2-Nov-2026.
Management reportedly raised FY27 revenue growth guidance to ~30% (from ~25%) on the Q2 call (secondary report; not verified against the transcript).

facts.fact: PL (Prabhudas Lilladher) Q2FY27 note: Buy, target Rs4,693 (from Rs3,811), 53x Sep-29E EPS.
IDBI Capital: Buy, target Rs4,851 (price Rs3,892.6).
Dr Ashish Kumar Pandey appointed Assistant VP Operations; two senior management personnel reassigned.
Business Responsibility and Sustainability / Annual Sustainability Report FY2025-26 filed.
